title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.

You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Product Manager
description:
Overview:

**Product****Manager**

**BASIC SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Product Manager to shape and advance the strategy, development, and evolution of our healthcare claims administration platform. In this role, you will manage the product lifecycle from concept through release, driving initiatives that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value to customers. You will partner across the organization to define requirements, prioritize features, and ensure solutions are aligned with market trends, regulatory needs, and our long-term product vision.  
  
The ideal candidate blends healthcare industry expertise with strong product management skills, bringing a data-informed, customer-centric approach to decision-making. Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate requirements definition, backlog management, and analysis is a plus.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution**

* Contribute to the product roadmap in partnership with senior product leadership, ensuring alignment with market needs, business priorities, and strategic objectives
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to enhance product competitiveness through emerging technologies, regulatory changes, or evolving customer needs
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and quality assurance teams to deliver features that meet scope, quality, and timeline commitments
* Develop clear, value-driven epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria informed by market insights and stakeholder input
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and ensure delivery plans remain on track and adaptable to shifting priorities

**Market Insight & Requirements Leadership**

* Gather and synthesize insights from customers, market research, and internal teams to inform product decision
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable development items, leveraging AI-enabled tools for efficiency and consistency
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, market urgency, and customer value
* Partner with compliance teams to ensure product features meet healthcare regulations and security standards

**Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration**

* Serve as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams, ensuring shared understanding of product goals and constraints
* Work closely with UX/UI to advocate for user-centered design and optimal user experiences
* Partner with customer success, support, and marketing to enable effective go-to-market strategies, adoption, and customer education
* Engage with leadership to provide visibility into progress, risks, and product performance metrics

**Product Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze product usage data, KPIs, and customer feedback to identify enhancements and drive continuous optimization
* Support impact analysis for proposed changes and contribute to release planning to ensure seamless delivery
* Maintain awareness of industry shifts, competitive offerings, and payer/provider needs to inform future iterations and long-term vision

**MINIMUM REQUIRED****QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field  
  5+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or Agile product delivery
* Familiarity with healthcare or healthtech domains, ideally in payer systems or claims processing
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a SaaS or software development environment
* Experience with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) for backlog and requirements management
* Familiarity with AI-powered tools for requirements generation or analysis (preferred, not required)
* Understanding of Agile software development methodologies (Scrum or Kanban)
* Basic understanding of APIs, system integrations, and technical product documentation
* Working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, medical billing, and reimbursement models
* Familiarity with healthcare regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, HITECH) and data standards (HL7, X12, FHIR)
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Detail-oriented with excellent organization and documentation abilities
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute, or equivalent certification
* Experience supporting AI-driven or data-intensive product initiatives
* Exposure to healthcare cloud solutions or interoperability platforms
* Knowledge of payer systems, provider workflows, or value-based care initiatives

title: Product Manager, WhatsApp - India
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.WhatsApp Product Managers work with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, researchers and other partners to build products. We are looking for entrepreneurial Product Managers who combine long-term strategic thinking with urgency, product craft and effective execution.  
  
  

### **Product Manager, WhatsApp - India Responsibilities:**

* Lead a complex product area by defining its vision, strategy, and measures of success, while considering the wider WhatsApp and company context.
* Identify and prioritize the most significant user and product opportunities, adapting the strategy as new evidence and context emerge.
* Translate strategy into a coherent roadmap across multiple workstreams, driving progress against goals and resolving dependencies and blockers.
* Build alignment across adjacent product teams and partner functions, resolving divergent goals and creating shared strategies where needed.
* Use qualitative research, quantitative analysis, and market insight to inform product decisions and influence the broader product organization.
* Communicate the product strategy, trade-offs, and progress with clarity to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Raise the effectiveness of the team and support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional partners through mentorship and coaching.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 3 years in Product Management
* Experience leading consumer product strategy and execution at significant scale
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across the full product lifecycle, from defining product vision and requirements through launch, measurement, and iteration
* Experience using user research, experimentation, and large-scale data to identify opportunities, make trade-offs, and drive measurable product outcomes
* Experience integrating diverse user needs, product requirements, and competitive context into a coherent strategy
* Experience influencing across organizational boundaries and aligning senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, including bringing clarity to complex product decisions
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building products for diverse international audiences and markets
* Experience defining and validating zero-to-one consumer product opportunities
* Experience in designing audience, privacy or identity controls that help people share confidently
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, or team workflows while applying responsible AI practices
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building consumer products
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in a consumer-focused technology company, with in-market experience in India
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets
* Experience building and scaling early-stage growth efforts

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Cloud & Hosting - Senior Product Owner - Observability
description:
Business Introduction

  

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

  

The Senior Product Owner, Observability owns the backlog and roadmap for the Observability platform, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Director, Modern Engineering Platform Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.

* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs and measure the outcome with a named metric.

* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.

* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.

* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.

* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.

* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.

* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.

* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.

* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.

* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.

* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

  
  

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* 5+ years in technology, years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.

* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.

* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.

* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.

* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.

* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.

* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

* Hands-on expertise with modern observability tooling such as Grafana and Google Cloud Observability.

* Proven observability expertise across metrics, logs and traces, telemetry pipelines, dashboards and alerting, with accountability for reliability and cost.

* Experience delivering AI-driven or automated operations on observability data (desirable).

* Experience in a pharma, regulated or comparably complex enterprise environment (desirable).

  
  

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.

* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.

* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.

* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.

* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standard ground.

  

**Skills**

AI Observability, API Management, Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Grafana, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Product Ownership, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Product Owner: Market Maker & Options Clearing (VP)
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Business Execution Consultant, an experienced Product Owner (individual contributor) for planning, coordination, and delivering enhancements across Market Maker Clearing, Options Clearing, Trade Processing, Regulatory Reporting, Reconciliation, and Post-Trade Operations. The Product Owner manages product demand and the backlog, documents requirements, drives Agile delivery, coordinates stakeholders, leads testing and release readiness, and provides executive reporting to support successful execution of strategic, operational, and regulatory initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

Lead delivery management activities for assigned product capabilities within the Securities and Prime Services organization, partnering with global product managers and technology teams to manage execution, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments.

**Functional and Technical Skills**

**Product Ownership**

* Execute the product roadmap across Market Maker Clearing, Options Clearing, Equity Clearing, Trade Processing, Reconciliation, Regulatory Reporting, and Post-Trade Operations.
* Evaluate business requests, operational needs, stakeholder feedback, control requirements, and regulatory obligations to prioritize the backlog and plan delivery.
* Manage the product demand and intake process, ensuring requests are documented, assessed, tracked, prioritized, and routed appropriately.
* Maintain visibility into product initiatives, outcomes, dependencies, milestones, capacity, risks, assumptions, and delivery commitments.
* Manage quarterly planning activities, including Big Room Planning (BRP), capacity reviews, dependency management, prioritization, and roadmap coordination.
* Partner with Product Managers to define intended outcomes, clarify scope and acceptance measures, evaluate solution options, and drive delivery from concept through implementation.
* Assess impacts across business processes, technology platforms, operating models, controls, regulatory reporting, and client or counterparty servicing.

**Agile Delivery and Requirements Management**

* Create, refine, and maintain Capabilities, Epics, Features, User Stories, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and process flows in Jira.
* Partner with Business Analysts and Technology teams to translate complex business and operational needs into clear, testable, and actionable work items.
* Own backlog refinement and prioritization; lead or support sprint planning, story reviews, retrospectives, backlog reviews, and daily scrum meetings as needed.
* Track delivery progress, resolve gaps, and identify and escalate risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies in a timely manner.
* Evaluate solution options and document impacts to clearing workflows, operational processes, controls, data, and downstream consumers.

**Testing, Release Readiness and Production Governance**

* Lead or coordinate user acceptance testing, test planning, traceability, evidence management, defect triage, production validation, and post-implementation reviews.
* Coordinate implementation planning, release readiness, stakeholder communications, training materials, rollout activities, support procedures, and production preparedness.
* Ensure processes, controls, support procedures, business continuity considerations, and target operating models are documented and validated before implementation.
* Support root cause analysis, incident remediation, production issues, audit and compliance requests, and sustainable corrective actions.

**Stakeholder Coordination and Governance**

* Coordinate Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Business, and Control stakeholders to drive delivery activities and decisions.
* Lead working sessions, planning meetings, governance reviews, execution checkpoints, and cross-workstream coordination.
* Maintain action, decision, issue, risk, assumption, and dependency logs; establish clear owners and drive timely resolution of blockers.
* Manage and respond to internal and external inquiries related to product capabilities, delivery commitments, controls, and ongoing initiatives.

**Process Improvement, Data, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and execute opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale product and operational processes.
* Use automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, improve delivery efficiency, and enhance decision-making.
* Develop dashboards, metrics, and management reporting covering roadmap delivery, testing, capacity, risks, controls, and operational readiness.
* Use AI-supported documentation, analysis, planning, testing, reporting, and communication judiciously, with appropriate review for accuracy, context, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

**Executive Communication**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with product specialists, clearing and operations teams, technology partners, control functions, and senior leaders across global businesses.
* Create concise, executive-ready presentations and updates that clearly explain business outcomes, delivery status, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
* Translate complex clearing, platform, operational, and regulatory issues into clear, outcome-oriented conversations and practical recommendations.
* Build trusted relationships and strong communication channels across business, operations, product, technology, risk, compliance, and control partners.
* Influence without direct authority and drive alignment in a global, highly matrixed organization.

**Change Mindset, Collaboration and Ownership**

* Work effectively at the intersection of clearing domain expertise, product ownership, business analysis, and delivery management.
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and seek to understand end-to-end business processes, technology platforms, data flows, controls, and operational workflows.
* Run toward complex problems, challenge assumptions constructively, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.
* Collaborate across global teams to shape solutions, resolve dependencies, gain stakeholder alignment, and drive decisions through implementation.
* Operate with ownership, accountability, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a bias toward action, while managing multiple priorities with limited oversight.
* Demonstrate adaptability and continuous learning, including responsible adoption of emerging automation, analytics, and AI capabilities.

**Risk and Control Mindset**

* Embed risk and control considerations into product design, backlog prioritization, requirements, testing, release readiness, and implementation.
* Ensure product capabilities and delivery processes comply with applicable regulatory, operational, governance, resiliency, data security, privacy, and internal risk-framework requirements.
* Identify and escalate delivery, operational, conduct, technology, data, and regulatory risks in a timely manner.
* Support audit, compliance, resiliency, control remediation, and business continuity activities, ensuring actions are traceable and sustainably closed.
* Ensure responsible use of AI and automation with appropriate awareness of data privacy, information security, ethical, governance, and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* MBA or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 5+ years of mandatory experience across Capital Markets, Securities Processing, Equities, Listed Options, Clearing, Trade Processing, Post-Trade Operations, Product Management, or related functions.
* Experience supporting equity and/or listed options clearing workflows, with knowledge of trade lifecycle processing and operational controls.
* 5+ years of experience working with Agile delivery methodologies, Jira, business analysis, requirements management, backlog management, and cross-functional execution.
* Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives, solve complex problems, and deliver – from concept through implementation.
* Strong organizational, planning, analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready presentations and present information to persuade, educate, and enhance understanding at all levels.
* Ability to work effectively in a demanding, fast-paced, global environment, handling multiple priorities while maintaining quality, accuracy, integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* Experience identifying and driving process improvements in complex environments.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Direct experience with Options Clearing, including listed options lifecycle events, OCC workflows, allocations, exercise and assignment, settlement, reconciliation, and related controls.
* Experience with Market Maker Clearing, Equity Clearing, Trade Processing, Regulatory Reporting, Reconciliation, or Post-Trade Operations.
* Experience consulting with internal clients and business partners and working successfully with all levels of leadership.
* Experience delivering regulatory, compliance, audit, resiliency, or control-remediation initiatives.
* Demonstrated success leveraging automation, AI tools, analytics, workflow technologies, dashboards, metrics, or low-code platforms to improve outcomes.
* Experience with front to back testing governance, operational readiness, production support, service management, quarterly planning, capacity management, prioritization, and delivery governance.
* Data mining, modeling, and analysis experience.
* Self-motivated, intellectually curious, adaptable, collaborative, and execution-focused, with the ability to learn independently and operate with limited supervision.

**Work Arrangement, Shift Timings & Flexibility:**

* **Work Model:** Hybrid working model with a minimum requirement of three (3) days per week from office.
* **Flexibility:** The role requires reasonable flexibility to attend stakeholder meetings or calls as needed during US business hours and to provide support for weekend activities, as required, particularly during release and deployment windows.

22 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. title: Product Manager
description:
**About Turing**
================

Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

**About the Role**

Turing is looking for a high-caliber Product Manager to lead critical product areas across our talent, marketplace, vetting, and platform ecosystem. This person will step into a high-ownership role and should be able to combine strong product judgment, design taste, data-driven decision making, technical fluency, and structured business thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of user experience, systems thinking, analytics, and execution — someone who is equally comfortable shaping product direction, defining elegant user experiences, and driving cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment.

**Why this role matters**

Turing works with many of the world's leading AI labs and enterprises to help build, improve, and scale advanced AI systems. We sit at the intersection of frontier AI, high-quality talent, and complex product/platform workflows - which means the problems here are real, hard, and highly consequential.

This role sits at the core of how Turing builds scalable, high-quality experiences across talent and customer workflows. The right person will help raise the bar on product execution, clarity of thinking, and quality of experience across the organization.

**What you'll own**

You will lead product strategy and execution across some of Turing's most important platform surfaces, including areas such as:

* Talent discovery, search, and matching
* Talent onboarding and profile quality
* Vetting, trust, and integrity systems
* Marketplace workflows and hiring manager experience
* Internal platforms and operational tooling
* Cross-functional product initiatives spanning product, engineering, design, data, and operations

**What you'll do**

* Own roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a core product area
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured product plans, clear requirements, and strong execution
* Drive product development with a sharp eye for user experience, workflow design, and quality
* Use data deeply to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, prioritize investments, and measure impact
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, QA, and operations to ship high-quality products quickly
* Balance short-term execution with long-term product and platform thinking
* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems
* High ownership, urgency, and a strong bias for execution

**Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or a similarly rigorous discipline, ideally from a top-tier institution such as IIT or equivalent globally recognized universities
* MBA from a top-tier university is a plus, but not required
* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products
* Strong track record of partnering closely with engineering and design teams to ship polished, high-quality user experiences

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**
----------

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**Advantages of joining Turing**
--------------------------------

* **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
* **Contribute to leading-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
* **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
* **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
* **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

  

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

Minimum of 5+ years of product management experience with strong focus on building and delivering successful data products, services and capabilities Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required, such as engineering, math, science, economics, etc.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Quality Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process.
  
**Must have skills :** Java Full Stack Development  
**Good to have skills :** Spring Boot  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Role Summary  
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches — writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard.  
Key Responsibilities  
  
Hands-On Technical Contribution  
Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction.  
Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment.  
Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly.  
Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment — not just review others' work.  
Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards.  
Actively use and champion AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow.  
  
Technical Leadership  
Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling.  
Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct.  
Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team.  
Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment.  
  
Team Management & Delivery:  
Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself.  
Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching.  
Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions — and then build them yourself.  
Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability.  
  
Required Qualifications:  
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development — you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past.  
Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.  
Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills — query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently.  
Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments.  
Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred).  
  
Preferred Qualifications:  
OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience.  
Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns.  
Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

  
15 years full time education

title: Manager, Account Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Account ManagementMastercard is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented professional to join the Financial Institutions (FI) team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions while identifying new business opportunities that drive revenue growth and expand Mastercard's presence within the banking ecosystem.  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to customers, developing deep stakeholder relationships, uncovering opportunities for collaboration, and delivering innovative payment solutions that create mutual value. The role requires a combination of relationship management, business development, strategic thinking, and commercial execution.  
  
Key Responsibilities  

* Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of Banks and Financial Institutions, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to strengthen existing client relationships, increase customer engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Identify opportunities within existing customer portfolios to expand Mastercard's products, services, and solutions, generating incremental revenue and increasing market share.
* Proactively scout for and secure new business opportunities with existing and prospective banking partners to achieve business development objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers, including CXOs, Business Heads, Product Heads, Payments Heads, Cards Leaders, and Digital Banking stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to understand their strategic priorities and align Mastercard solutions to support their growth ambitions.
* Lead customer engagements and business discussions to identify opportunities across card issuance, digital payments, acceptance, commercial solutions, value-added services, and emerging payment technologies.
* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new and existing Mastercard products and solutions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Franchise, Customer Solutions, Consulting, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver customer-centric solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Analyse customer portfolios, market trends, competitive dynamics, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities and formulate winning strategies.
* Prepare business cases, commercial proposals, and account growth plans to support customer acquisition and portfolio expansion.
* Lead and support commercial negotiations, partnership discussions, and contract renewals to maximize customer value and business outcomes.
* Track account performance, pipeline opportunities, revenue contribution, and execution against business targets.
* Drive assigned strategic initiatives and projects from concept through implementation, ensuring successful execution and measurable business impact.

  
About You  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.
* Experience in Relationship Management, Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Product Management within the Banking, Payments, Cards, Fintech, or broader BFSI sector.
* Demonstrated experience managing relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions.
* Proven ability to strengthen existing customer relationships and identify new opportunities that drive incremental revenue growth.
* Strong track record of delivering revenue targets, portfolio growth, and market expansion.
* Deep understanding of the payment’s ecosystem, including cards, digital payments, issuing, acquiring, and banking products.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience developing business cases, commercial proposals, and partnership strategies.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence senior decision makers both internally and externally.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated leadership through influence and collaboration across cross-functional teams.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Overview**

Security is one of the most critical challenges facing organisations today. Threats are becoming more sophisticated, enterprise environments are increasingly diverse, and AI is rapidly changing both how attacks are carried out and how security products are built and operated.

Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.

We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.

This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.

* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.

* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.

* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.

* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.

* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.

* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.

* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.

* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.

* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.

* Experience working with large enterprise customers and security operations or IT administration personas.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Endpoint Security: Deep understanding of endpoint protection, threat detection, and endpoint detection and response across modern enterprise environments.

* Device & Mobile Security: Experience with Microsoft Intune or equivalent device management and security solutions, including mobile device/application management, device compliance, and Android/iOS security.

* Enterprise & Cross-Platform Security: Experience securing diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with a strong understanding of the needs of large enterprise customers, security operations teams, and IT administrators.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

title: Assistant Brand Manager, Sports, Amazon, Sports GL
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you ready to shape the future of retail by driving brand growth and optimizing customer experiences at scale? This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of merchandizing, marketing, and operations. Throughout the day, you'll analyze customer behavior data, optimize merchandizing assets, and make data-driven decisions to improve brand performance. When opportunities or issues arise, you'll engage directly with brand partners to collaborate on solutions that drive measurable outcomes.  
  
About the team  
You'll join a dynamic team focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences through strategic brand management and innovative merchandizing solutions. Qualcomm India Private Limited

**General Summary:**

Job Title: Engineer BTSW-HOST

Department Name & No.: 50736 - WRD Tech QuIC Tech BT Host SW - BDC

Available to New or Recent Graduate: No

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

* Designs and implements small software features for products and systems.

* Participates in the design, coding for small features, unit testing, minor debugging fixes, and integration efforts to ensure projects are completed on schedule.

* Assists in performing code reviews and regression tests as well as the triaging of issues to ensure the quality of code.

**Level of Responsibility:**

* Requires verbal and written communication skills to convey basic, routine factual information.

* Tasks require multiple steps which can be performed in various orders; some planning, problem-solving, and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively.

This role combines people leadership with technical direction across Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, board support packages, system services, device integration, and user experience. The manager will guide a multidisciplinary team through architecture, development, validation, release, and sustainment, partnering across product, hardware, quality, security, and operations to deliver high-quality embedded products.

Success in this role means establishing technical clarity, raising engineering quality, and shipping platform capabilities that are scalable, secure, testable, and intuitive for the people who use them.

**What You Will Do**

**Technical / Managerial Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design and implementation of embedded OS platform architecture using Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, aligning platform choices with product, hardware, security, and UX goals.

  

* Own the team roadmap, architectural direction, technical debt strategy, and delivery plans for platform, middleware, device integration, and embedded UX capabilities.

  

* Provide technical leadership across board support packages, bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, system services, and application frameworks.

  

* Partner with Product, UX, Hardware, Systems, Quality, and Security teams to translate customer workflows into coherent, responsive, and accessible device experiences.

  

* Establish reproducible build and release practices, including source control, code review, continuous integration, automated validation, artifact traceability, and release governance.

  

* Strengthen product quality through unit, integration, system, performance, reliability, hardware-in-the-loop, and end-to-end testing across target devices.

  

* Guide secure platform engineering, including secure boot, signed software, permissions, vulnerability remediation, SBOM practices, and over-the-air update strategies.

  

* Work closely with Release Engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the smooth operation of build, test, packaging, deployment, and sustaining-engineering workflows.

  

* Drive functional excellence initiatives, deliver high-quality R&D functional deliverables, and ensure technical excellence for product or technology development. Drive technical projects of major magnitude and scope.

  

* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, applying this knowledge to continuously improve embedded platform architecture, development practices, and UX quality.

  

* Act as a performance coach by providing actionable feedback, setting clear objectives, developing technical talent, and building an inclusive, accountable engineering culture.

  

* Communicate plans, risks, trade-offs, and technical information clearly to team members and business stakeholders, supporting decisions with evidence and sound engineering judgment.

**What You Will Need**

**Technical Skills**

  

* Strong experience building and shipping embedded Linux and/or Android-based products, with a practical understanding of OS architecture, system startup, resource management, and device lifecycle.

  

* Hands-on expertise with the Yocto Project, including custom layers, recipes, image generation, SDKs, reproducible builds, package management, and distro or machine configuration.

  

* Experience with Android OS or AOSP, including the Android build system, framework services, HALs, permissions, system applications, OTA updates, and platform customization.

  

* Proficiency in modern C/C++ and scripting with Python and shell; familiarity with Java or Kotlin for Android platform and application integration is a plus.

  

* Deep understanding of BSP development, U-Boot or other bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, middleware, and hardware abstraction layers.

  

* Experience with embedded UX technologies such as Android UI, Qt/QML, Wayland/Weston, or comparable frameworks, including performance, responsiveness, and accessibility considerations.

  

* Working knowledge of hardware and connectivity interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and display or input subsystems.

  

* Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as GDB, perf, ftrace, kernel logs, logcat, crash dumps, tracing, and system observability tooling.

  

* Experience with CI/CD and engineering tools such as Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.

  

* Understanding of embedded security, secure boot, code signing, key management, vulnerability response, SBOMs, and long-term product maintenance.

  

* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative, evidence-based solutions.

  

* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in Agile, cross-functional, and geographically distributed development environments.

**Leadership Experience**

  

* Talented performance coach who is skilled at providing actionable feedback to team members, setting clear performance objectives, and managing team member performance.

  

* Experience executing a talent and performance-management strategy, including hiring, onboarding, development planning, succession planning, and organizational health.

  

* Demonstrated ability to communicate plans and technical information to team members and stakeholders within a business unit.

  

* Proven ability to deliver programs or other business goals on time, on quality, and within budget while managing scope, risk, dependencies, and trade-offs.

  

* Ability to balance hands-on technical depth with thoughtful delegation, coaching, and long-term team capability building.

**Education & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field required; master's degree in a related field preferred.

  

* 15+ years of applicable experience, with 6+ years of direct people-management experience preferred.

  

* A strong level of understanding and experience in one's technical or functional disciplines, with the ability to mentor others and raise the engineering bar.
