title: Data Design and DelivData Design and Delivery Specialistery Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Data Solution Lead (Group PMO Hub India) in Banglore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your business analysis and data analytics expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and motivated teammates.

You'll play a key role in driving Alstom's digital transformation by enabling data-driven decision-making and delivering impactful analytics solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as the Group PMO, Product Line Offices, Region Project Offices, and Talent/HR Management), lead stakeholder engagements to understand and deliver on business requirements, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of developing and maintaining Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Business Objects, and ensuring alignment with business objectives. You’ll also manage user access, specify and test enhancements, and oversee application upgrades.

We’ll look to you for:

* Engaging with stakeholders to collect, document, and prioritize business requirements for analytics and digital solutions.
* Designing and developing dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support fast decision-making by Project and Bid Managers.
* Collaborating with IS/IT partners to define data architecture and ensure accurate and reliable data sources.
* Facilitating requirements and design reviews to secure stakeholder alignment and feedback.
* Driving user-centric design principles to maximize usability and adoption of analytics solutions.
* Coordinating testing, business validation, user acceptance, and deployment readiness.
* Monitoring solution utilization and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Experience in business analysis, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of Business Intelligence and Data Visualization platforms such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Tableau.
* Familiarity with data mapping, data quality principles, and reporting best practices.
* A certification in Business Analysis, Project Management, Data Analytics, Agile, or Scrum is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational abilities.
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with diverse, transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards broader leadership or technical roles within Alstom.
* Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Product Manager - ZTNA experience is required
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

### **About Cloud Secure Edge**

Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall's cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that provides enterprise-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN-as-a-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall's SASE transformation.

### **The Role**

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will connect engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform's evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall's SASE and Zero Trust go-to-market objectives.
* Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
* Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.

#### **Technical Product Ownership**

* Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
* Drive integration strategy across SonicWall's security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
* Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
* Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi-tenancy, scalability, and cloud-native deployment models.

#### **Zero Trust & SASE Domain Leadership**

* Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
* Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
* Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.

#### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Go-to-Market**

* Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
* Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design-partner programs, and gather feedback.
* Support sales engineering teams with technical deep-dives, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements.
* Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
* Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
* Proven track record of shipping cloud-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi-tenant platforms.
* Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C-level stakeholders..

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a cybersecurity vendor in the SASE or SSE market (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Netskope, Fortinet).
* Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
* Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
* Background in data-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
* AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

title: Associate Product Manager - Onboarding
description:
Overview:

***Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity***

With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

At StoneX, we offer you the opportunity to be part of an institutional-grade financial services network that connects companies, organizations, and investors to the global markets ecosystem. As a team member, you'll benefit from our unique blend of digital platforms, comprehensive clearing and execution services, personalized high-touch support, and deep industry expertise. Elevate your career with us and make a significant impact in the world of global finance.

Immerse yourself in the best-in-class institutional-grade technology, working alongside industry experts and gaining exposure to various asset classes, such as equities, options, fixed income securities, and advanced trading, research, and management technology.

Responsibilities:

**Position Purpose:**

StoneX is modernising client onboarding and setup across the firm. This multi-year programme will replace fragmented and duplicated processes with a controlled, scalable capability spanning due diligence and KYC/AML through account creation, entitlements, credit and risk setup, reference data and trading readiness.

The Onboarding Product Management team bridges the technical and business worlds, working closely with Engineering, Business Analysis, Compliance/AML and other business functions to deliver this capability. As an Associate Product Manager, you will lead analysis within defined onboarding workstreams, work with stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, and help translate agreed changes into product and delivery outcomes. This may include exploring how automation and AI could streamline onboarding processes.

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn product management, work with stakeholders across regions and business lines, and influence how the onboarding experience is delivered.

**Primary duties will include:**

* Leading the analysis of current-state onboarding processes within assigned workstreams, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, control and client experience.
* Engaging stakeholders across regions and business lines to gather input, validate findings and support recommendations.
* Collecting and analysing feedback, product analytics and market insights to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
* Working with large data sets to identify volumes, bottlenecks and trends across onboarding processes.
* Translating product ideas into clear requirements and deliverables.
* Partnering with senior Product Managers to shape onboarding product strategy and roadmap.
* Supporting the design of the end-to-end client experience across applicable systems.
* Acting as an onboarding solutions and KYC processes subject-matter expert, representing the onboarding team internally and externally.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a field related to business, technology, or client solutions.
* Experience in business analysis, process analysis or product management, ideally within financial services (experience in KYC/AML, compliance, or onboarding is a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess processes, identify inefficiencies and propose practical improvements.
* Comfort working with large data sets to identify trends and support evidence-based recommendations.
* Experience using, or willingness to use, AI tools to support analysis and assessment work.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies, backlog management, and product delivery practices.

**What makes you stand out:**

* A relevant accreditation in Business Analysis.
* Knowledge of client onboarding and setup, including KYC/AML, client due diligence, account and entity creation, entitlements, credit and risk.
* Exposure or experience working on onboarding transformation projects across multiple regions and legal entities.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to drive decisions without direct authority.

**Working environment:**

* In-office – 4 days a week.
* Some travel may be required to support stakeholder engagement across regions.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.  
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.

#### **What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
* Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
* Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.
* Engage directly with engineering customers and users including senior engineering leadership as the primary audience for this product, translating their needs into roadmap decisions.
* Represent the product in high-visibility, customer-facing moments with composure, including when executives engage directly and unexpectedly.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship production-quality, AI-native interview experiences.
* Embrace AI - in how we operate, as well as in the product.

#### **Who you are**

* Overall 7+ years of total professional experience including at least 1 year of hands-on Software Engineering.
* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably building B2B SaaS, enterprise products and/or tech services and/or platforms, and you are currently working as a PM today.
* Comfortable being the technical/product voice in a room full of engineers, including stakeholders like senior engineering leadership
* Able to stay composed and sound under sudden high-visibility pressure for example, a CTO persona dropping into a live customer channel.
* A strategic thinker who can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* Deeply passionate about AI using it as a reflex across your own workflows, not just in the product you build.
* Ability to deep dive into ambitious problem statements and create customer value.
* Proven track record of successfully launching and growing new products and/or significant features.
* Ability to work in a fast paced cross team, cross geo environment and to deliver on a common vision.
* Ability to work with engineers, designers and analysts and be comfortable presenting to non-technical/business stakeholders and customers.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Hands-on fluency with agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or similar) deep enough to reason about what a good AI-assisted engineering actually looks like.
* Experience designing or owning a GTM motion where the buyer and user were engineers or engineering leadership, rather than a traditional non-technical economic buyer.
* Experience operating in a lean, founder-style team with no dedicated marketing support i.e., you've personally built your own sales decks, messaging and customer-facing materials before, not just briefed a marketing team.
* Background in HR tech, talent assessment, or technical hiring.
* Experience building reporting/analytics or API-level integrations (e.g. MCP, data exports) for a technical audience.

#### **You will thrive in this role if you**

* **You are a builder at heart.** You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.
* **Ambiguity excites you**. You're comfortable working in undefined spaces, carving out clarity where little exists, and defining a clear vision and strategy.
* **You take a customer-first approach.** You excel at identifying unmet customer needs and turning those insights into innovative product solutions.
* **You are a strategic thinker.** You can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and make decisions that balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* **You thrive in fast-paced environments.** You're energised by working on high-impact initiatives where priorities can shift as you gain new insights.
* **You have a bias for action.** You're not afraid to experiment, iterate, and learn quickly in pursuit of delivering exceptional outcomes.
* **You are deeply passionate about AI.** You're in the weeds and trying out AI tools constantly and are at a point where you are using AI as a reflex to try and automate several workflows in your life and 10x yourself.

**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.

HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

* *Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.*
* *We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.*

title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Experience building or scaling a product function — hiring and mentoring product managers, delivery leads, or program managers.
* Familiarity with modern detection engineering concepts (behavioral analytics, ML-based detection, identity threat detection) sufficient to evaluate technical proposals critically.

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

### **Position Description**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship & State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security & Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product & Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality & Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving & Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**

* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**

* **B.S. or M.S.** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Product Manager – AI & Digital Solutions**

**Role Overview**
=================

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle—from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement—for one or more solutions within CDW’s Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
===============================

**Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

**Solution Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

**Solution Development & Delivery**

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

**AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

**Working Model**
=================

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education and/or Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Digital Workplace
* Infrastructure Modernization

Experience with:

* Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

**Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**
=========================================

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

*The information in this position description is intended to convey information about the key responsibilities and requirements of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of the skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the opportunity. Position Descriptions are subject to change.*

**Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**
==========================================================

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW’s commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
* During your orientation period, review with your supervisor as needed the quality procedures and operating instructions listed at Connect/Departments/Resources/ISO intranet site that apply to your specific assignment(s) within the scope of this job position.
* And after the orientation period to conform to these procedures and instructions, including any reporting (and/or record keeping) responsibilities.
* Report any client problem, or any service outage that may cause potential client problems to your supervisor.

**CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization**
=======================================================

* We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. title: Senior Manager - Engineering
description:
**Who are we?**  

  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e\-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.


We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  

Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self\-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.


We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  

From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.


Working at Myntra is challenging but fun \- we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.


  
Job Description: Engineering Manager \- Developer Velocity Platform Engineering Myntra s Engineering team builds the technology platform that empowers our customers shopping experience and enables the smooth flow of products from suppliers to our customers doorsteps. We work on building massive\-scale web applications, engaging user interfaces, big\-data analytics, mobile apps, workflow systems, inventory management, etc. You will have the opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing organisation and gain exposure to all the parts of a comprehensive e\-commerce platform. About The Team The Cloud Platform Engineering(CPE) group is responsible for developing and managing platforms that allow Myntra s tech products to be deployed and run at scale. The CPE team builds and maintains centralized and high\-scale platforms for sophisticated application security frameworks, log collection, monitoring systems, access management, secret management, database access, change management systems, build, release and deployment. You will be part of the group. You will develop distributed solutions with service\-oriented architecture to build high\-performance platforms to service India's largest selection of millions of fashion customers. Furthermore, you will build Tier\-1 services to handle millions of requests daily while maintaining response latencies in milliseconds and meeting strict SLA requirements (high operational standards). You will not merely go through the complete software development cycle but, more importantly, drive appropriate technology choices for the business, lead the way for continuous innovation, and shape the future of fashion e\-commerce. The Role We are looking for an Engineering Manager who thinks like a product manager for developers. This is not a DevOps maintenance role. It is a hands\-on engineering leadership role with a specific mandate: make every moment of the Myntra engineer's day faster, clearer, and less frustrating and build the AI\-native developer platform that compounds that improvement for years. You will own the CI/CD systems, the Internal Developer Portal, the agentic support tooling, and the DORA programme. Everything that affects how an engineer writes, ships, and debugs code at Myntra is yours. Your customers are Myntra's engineers. Self\-Serve Ratio visible and actionable for every engineering team Long\-term: Build the future Lead the design and delivery of Myntra's Internal Developer Platform (IDP) a self\-serve, golden\-path developer experience that abstracts infrastructure complexity entirely Own the CI/CD pipeline overhaul move from a legacy multi\-system pipeline to a modern, observable, AI\-augmented delivery platform Build the CPE Bot a natural language interface for IAM, build failure diagnosis, deployment queries, and infrastructure questions; eliminate the highest\-volume ticket categories permanently Drive AI\-native development practices across Myntra engineering repo context enrichment, AI\-assisted build failure analysis, autonomous PR agents, and VPC coding agents integrated into CI/CD Design the developer platform for GCP natively as part of the ongoing cloud migration not retrofitted after the fact Required Technical Expertise Developer experience and platform thinking Deep understanding of what makes a platform feel like a product you have built internal developer portals, golden paths, or self\-serve frameworks that engineers choose to use, not just comply with Hands\-on experience with CI/CD systems at scale you have designed, built, and operated pipelines, not just consumed them Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, and modern deployment patterns canary, blue\-green, progressive delivery Familiarity with DORA metrics as a feedback loop you have run programmes that measurably improved deployment frequency, Lead Time to Change, or Change Failure Rate at a prior organisation Experience with IDP frameworks Backstage, Port, or equivalent AI\-native mindset You treat AI tooling as infrastructure, not a feature Cursor, Claude Code, and coding agents are autonomous PR agents, or equivalent You understand agentic workflows and have clear opinions about where human judgment is irreplaceable and where automation should be the default You can design title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Overview:

The Senior Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product roadmap established by the Product Management leadership team and meet business objectives. The person in this position manages multiple teams and backlogs for more than one product and/or for more complex products. This role is responsible for defining the detailed product deliverables. The Senior Product Owner must have a firm understanding of the business domain and product needs taking into account multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile teams have all of the information needed to deliver a product that provides maximum value to the users.
Duties \& Responsibilities:
* Collaborate with Product Managers to understand the market demands, priorities, and overall product strategy.
* Partner with UX and Product Managers on market research efforts to understand and prioritize customer needs.
* Work with one or more engineering teams to deliver timely, quality releases that provide high business value and exceed customer expectations.
* Flexibility to support more than one product within a portfolio, potentially across value streams
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
* Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
* Understand user personas and partner with UX to develop
* Create detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.
* Write user stories and establish acceptance criteria in collaboration with the team.
* Actively participate in PI planning, product sprints and daily stand\-up meetings
* Research and clarify details as the team develops the application
* Be aware of customer commitments in order to communicate internally to assist with managing team expectations
* Manage dependencies in and across sprints and releases
* Work with the Agile team to manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure alignment with changing business needs.
* Prioritize support work as needed
* Assist with system status communication and escalation as needed including customer communication
* Perform demos to all stakeholders on a regular basis
* Keep stakeholders apprised of progress and incorporate their feedback
* Understand project budgets, scope and timelines and work to maintain a balance
* Use metrics and feedback to improve team and organization processes, best practices, performance, and delivery
* May provide work direction or guidance to colleagues with less experience
* Act as a product champion within the company


Skills Required:
* Strong knowledge of Agile principles and process
* Anticipate needs and drive innovation in both business needs and technology enablers.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Familiarity with Microsoft SQL for creating queries
* Ability to influence cross\-functional team without formal authority
* Excellent time management, resource organization and priority establishment skills with the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment
* Keen attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with diplomacy and tact, including when responding to resistance
* Ability to work with an optimistic attitude both independently and as part of a team
* Self\-motivated with strong, proven, analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Understands the importance of data flow, data integrity, and business process efficiency, as well as the potential role technology could play to improve or enhance them
* Works independently with limited guidance from manager
* Project management skills
* + Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
	+ Overall 4\+ years of experience in software development/ product management.
	+ Minimum of 2 years of proven software development experience as an Agile Product Owner or similar role
	+ Healthcare industry knowledge
	+ Demonstrated capabilities in being tech, business, and UX savvy
	+ Basic level of technical knowledge of development, databases, and operating systems related to the area being supported
	+ Have HEART. To work here, you must be:
	+ Humble – self\-aware and respectful
	+ Effective – measurably move the needle \& immeasurably add value
	+ Adaptable – innately curious and constantly changing
	+ Remarkable – stand out in some way
	+ Transparent – openly and honestly sharing knowledge  

Qualifications
Preferred:
	+ Master’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
	+ Business analysis/data experience
	+ Relevant certifications:
	+ Certified Product Owner and other certificates as preferred:
	+ Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or willingness to certify
	+ Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO)
	+ SAFe Product Owner
	+ PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP)
	+ Your Scrum Product Owner (Accredited Certification)
	+ EXIN Agile Scrum Product Owner

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate plays a crucial role in the Loans group, responsible for delivering on key operational tasks and driving excellence. This position offers valuable exposure to a wide range of banking processes, contributing to the seamless operation and success of our financial services. Join our dynamic team to make a significant impact and support our clients in a collaborative environment.


**Job Summary**


As a Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate within the Loans group, you will be responsible for closely monitoring and guiding your team to ensure all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are consistently met. You will oversee a variety of processes, including Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, Pre\-payments, Funding, Rate\-Fixings, Fees, and external payments. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your skills in managing Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation and make a significant impact on our operations.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Monitor the team daily to ensure all SLAs are met and escalate exceptions immediately for resolution.
* Supervise processes such as Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, and Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation.
* Ensure adherence to quality and quantity SLAs and maintain a robust workflow allocation model.
* Serve as the SME, handling complex process\-related queries and routing them to onshore teams if needed.
* Implement a robust Knowledge Management model, including SOP maintenance and training.
* Drive 100% compliance with process\-related policies, guidelines, and controls.
* Motivate and support team members to meet goals, identifying high\-potential employees and planning for their development.
* Identify alternatives and options for issues, seeking alternative scenarios.
* Work successfully with others, valuing diverse skills and building interdependence.
* Identify training needs to improve performance and ensure compliance with training timelines.
* Ensure high team depth with trained backups for critical work queues.

* Hold a Bachelor's degree with minimum 8 years of relevant experience in credit support or loan servicing, ideally in syndicated loans or financial industry roles.
* Gain knowledge of loan systems such as Loan IQ.
* Possess expertise in nostro/cash matching, General Ledger reconciliation, and SWIFT/remittance systems.
* Demonstrate strong problem\-solving and investigative skills to analyze and resolve process\-related issues.
* Maintain a robust risk and control mindset.

title: Staff Product Manager – Digital Assets
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.



Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.



It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.



Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.



In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.

 **About the Role**



Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100\+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off\-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.



We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto\-funded card, or a fiat\-to\-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go\-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol



### **Responsibilities**


* Own stablecoin\-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it.
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi\-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line.
* Design and ship on/off\-ramp flows — fiat\-to\-digital and digital\-to\-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience.
* Drive stablecoin\-based cross\-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production\-grade.
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy.
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal.
### **Requirements**

* 7\+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required.
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off\-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck.
* Strong payments foundation — cross\-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it.
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no\-go decisions.
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against.
* Comfortable operating in high\-ambiguity, high\-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign\-off.
### **How We’ll Measure Success**


* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins \+ payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin\-funded card products
* On/off\-ramp conversion rate and time\-to\-settlement
* Time\-to\-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product
**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year\-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role\-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company\-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

**We Thrive with Diversity:** Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18\+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.  


**Beware of recruitment scams:** Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon - Sub Same Day
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Across Emerging Markets (10 countries across APAC, MENA and LATAM), Amazon has an opportunity to engage the next 500MM customers and build a $100B GMS profitable business in the next 3 years. The Sub Same Day team will build for this market to deliver shopping orders to our customers within the same day in a reliable manner. The program is rapidly growing, is highly cross\-functional in nature, intensive and requires a number of solutions to be built and scaled. We build extensible EM first solutions to drive SSD program’s product strategy and Improve Fulfillment Convenience for customers while reducing overall Cost to Serve.  

  

This role is responsible for driving a roadmap specifically for daily essentials, grocery, perishables served from Sub Same Day network at Amazon across IES. If you like to swim in unchartered territories then this is your opportunity to solve problems that no one has attempted to solve at our scale before. We work like an high\-octane startup driven by the passion to bring the Amazon experience to our customers across Emerging Marketplaces.
  

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be expected to come up with the PR/FAQ, vision, and business requirements for the some of the most impactful ideas contributing to customer experience WW. This will need you to understand pain points of various types of customers, prioritize business needs that could be different across countries, while coming up with well thought out product ideas that leverage some of the latest advancements in technology. You will launch products, and take them to market, demonstrating business impact across countries.  

  

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about managing challenging, lengthy projects across multiple teams and locations and will run their initiatives like a business owner. They will be comfortable marshaling large amounts of data, and expert with new\-age technology domains to make recommendations and build business cases. We are looking for a tenured Product leader who shares Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great experience. In addition, the candidate will also be able to influence without authority and earn trust of a wide range of cross\-functional, tech/non\-tech stakeholders.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Identify and prioritize the most impactful improvement opportunities across New and Existing customers specific to their Sub Same Day delivery experiences across all emerging markets
* Be the voice of the customer advocating for the ideal customer experience
* Build products creating meaningful long term positive impact to the business
* Align key/Senior stakeholders to a bold vision for SSD through PRFAQs and other strategy documents
* strive to build products improving the delivery experience and speed for our customers
* Benchmark competitive experiences across Emerging Countries (outside of North Americas, Japan, UK), and define and implement a roadmap of improvements in customer Experience.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Master's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Experience in configuration \& Change management tools such as Plastic SCM, BitBucket, Gitlab, JIRA, Design tools such as EA, Unit testing tools such as TPT/CANTATA/VectorCAST/RTRT, Serial Comm testing tool such as CANoe/CANalyzer/NeoVI Fire, Cross compilers and debuggers like Lauterbach, Tasking.

* Collaborative style with the ability to communicate clearly on technical issues.

title: Teamhead Business Insights
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


The analytical engine that powers commercial decision\-making across Global eCommerce.


* Lead the Business Insights function and serve as the central insight engine for Global eCommerce, transforming data into actionable business recommendations across key commercial levers.
* Synthesize insights across merchandising, pricing, promotions, demand, marketing, CRM, content, customer behavior,supply chainand purchase performance to create a holistic view of business opportunities, risks, and performance gaps.
* Lead and develop a team of Business Insights Managers responsible for deep\-dive analytics, root\-cause analysis, opportunity sizing, and recommendation development.
* Establish scalable analytical frameworks, decision\-driver trees, playbooks, and workflows that enable consistent problem\-solving and performance improvement across markets.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making by ensuring insights are commercially relevant, actionable, and aligned to strategic priorities, with success measured through insight quality, recommendation adoption, and business value creation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Establish a performance diagnosis \& review rhythm focused on material changes, drivers, decisions and actions.
* Lead root\-cause investigations across core eCommerce\& customer KPIs by driver tree decomposition across customer funnel metrics
* Use driver trees, segmentation, scenario modeling and opportunity sizing to drive impactful decisions across key levers –buying, pricing, demand shaping, content, performance marketing \& CRM
* Apply driver trees, segmentation, cohort, funnel and variance analysis to explain performance changes.
* Form and test hypotheses, distinguish signal from noise and quantify the size of opportunities.
* Combine multiple data sources and business context into a coherent commercial view
* Synthesize insights generated across merchandising, pricing, promotions, demand, marketing, CRM, content, and customer analytics to develop cohesive, cross\-functional recommendations that maximize commercial impact and business performance.
* Connect functional deep dives into a unified business narrative, prioritizing the highest\-value opportunities and translating them into scalable action plans, playbooks, and market interventions.
* Steward reporting standards, analytical methodologies, data consumption frameworks and capability effectiveness. Ensure solutions remain commercially relevant, scalable, trusted and globally consistent. Build scalable playbooks which can be leveraged and replicated
* Lead, coach and develop Data Analysts and Data Storytelling specialists. Establish high standards for requirement definition, analytical rigor, business translation and executive communication.
* Act as the primary analytics capability partner across Product, Technology, Data Engineering, BI, AI/ML and global COE teams. Drive clarity on priorities, scope, dependencies and expected outcomes.
* Lead the translation of complex data and analytical insights into compelling, executive\-ready narratives that influence decision\-making and drive business outcomes across Global eCommerce.
**Your talent**
---------------


KEY REQUIREMENTS


* 9–12 years in analytics, business intelligence, strategy ,sales or in multi\-disciplinary experiences related to Ecom levers –pricing/ demand/ content/ CRM etc
* Experience in ecommerce or growth\-stage digital business mandatory with experience in insight generation from data
* Needs understanding of how each lever across merchandising, pricing, demand, marketing, CRM, content work together to drive commercial impact
* Experience working with complex datasets and translating findings into business recommendations..
* Experience in eCom platforms \-consumer or digital\-first brand businesses preferred; global matrix experience is advantageous.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Common Platforms builds the foundations every other product team depends on. Access, identity management, authentication and notifications are the foundation every Greenlight experience runs on, they decide who gets into the door, and whether the right person hears from us at the right moment. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Common Platforms to own this layer end\-to\-end: the Identity and access management, the permissions that govern what parents and kids can each do, and the multi\-channel notification platform that reaches millions of families every day.



This is a high\-leverage, high\-trust role at the center of Greenlight's platform organization. You'll work cross\-functionally across teams at Greenlight (US \& India) , and you'll have direct line\-of\-sight to executive leadership on the decisions that shape customer trust and platform reliability. The right person thinks in systems, and is comfortable building core platform products.



This role reports to the Director of Product and sits within the Common Platforms team.

* Working closely with Engineering and design to ensure building great product.

* Owning the key metrics for your product and ensuring the reliability of the product.

* Comfortable to build long term strategy for your product vertical and drive the key projects independently end to end.

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
