title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
description:
**Overview**
------------


Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid\-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration \& Onboarding Agent.


QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid\-sized businesses globally. The Mid\-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud\-native platforms.


Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high\-friction and high\-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.


This is a zero\-to\-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end\-to\-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post\-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net\-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain\-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time\-to\-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross\-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent\-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI\-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

 **Qualifications**

* Experience: 10\+ years in product management with 2\+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business\-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid\-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business\-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time\-to\-value.
* Cross\-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.


Preferred

* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top\-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). title: Sr Product Manager, Amazon Pharmacy
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon Pharmacy's Fulfillment Product team and shape the systems that determine how medications are dispensed, verified, and shipped to patients. You will execute the product roadmap to drive performance for the 1P Warehouse Management System (WMS) — the unified platform being built on AFT (Amazon Fulfillment Technologies) primitives to orchestrate pharmacy fulfillment within the four walls.  

Pharmacy fulfillment is unlike retail: workflows span controlled substance compliance (DEA chain\-of\-custody), cold chain handling, pharmacist verification gates, and dynamic re\-routing for problem states — all under HIPAA constraints. Every system you define and measure operates within these regulatory and operational realities, across small\-format sites, regional fulfillment centers, and kiosks.  

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager to own the product execution on how Amazon Pharmacy executes fill, verify, and pack — the core dispensing workflow that turns a prescription into a shipment. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers building workcell execution services, operator tooling, and the hardware abstraction layers that connect our software to pharmacy automation  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Define and execute the roadmap for how prescriptions are dispensed, pharmacist\-verified, and assembled into shipments across manual and automated workcells at all site formats (small\-format, regional, kiosks).  

2\. Define and track metrics across the fill\-verify\-pack pipeline; identify bottlenecks, set targets, and partner with engineering to deliver measurable improvements in speed, accuracy, and cost\-per\-shipment.  

3\. Work with Hardware and Software Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Clinical Excellence, Finance, and In\-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements  

4\. Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Product Manager I
description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.
We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
### **What you will do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 3\+ yrs with at least 1\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.
